title: Braille Image
description: An image drawn with braille characters, each cell's eight dots giving twice the horizontal and four times the vertical resolution of plain ASCII.

defaults.fontFamily: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace

docs.paused: Stop animating and hold the current frame.
docs.time: Render exactly this animation time, in milliseconds, and do not animate. Null animates.
docs.seed: Seed for every random choice, so the same seed always draws the same frame.
docs.src: Image URL or data URI. Empty draws a built-in lit sphere, so the component renders with no network.
docs.alt: Text alternative. Empty marks the image decorative and hides it from assistive technology.
docs.columns: Columns across the host. Rows follow from the host's height, or from the image when the host has none.
docs.threshold: Ink level a dot must reach to turn on. Raising it thins the image out; lowering it fills it in.
docs.dither: Spread the threshold over a 4 by 4 Bayer matrix, so mid-tones become dot patterns instead of a hard edge.
docs.contrast: Contrast around mid grey. 1 leaves the image as it is.
docs.fit: "cover" fills the host and crops; "contain" fits the whole image.
docs.tone: "auto" reads the host's colors. "light-on-dark" maps bright pixels to more dots; "dark-on-light" does the reverse.
docs.fontFamily: CSS font-family stack for the glyphs. Needs a font covering Braille Patterns, U+2800 to U+28FF.
docs.lineHeight: Line height as a multiple of the glyph size.
